summary: Practise title reviews, lease analysis and construction-contract risk checks. Explore the five-day foundation course and its applied exercises.
lede: Real estate law covers rights and obligations tied to land, buildings and property transactions. For property, legal, development and transaction professionals, this course offers a structured way to review documents and identify issues for escalation. Learners practise tracing title and encumbrances, assessing lease and transaction terms, and documenting contract risks in due-diligence matrices, risk registers and decision briefs.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who review, administer or make decisions about property rights, leases, transactions and development contracts. It is designed for professionals who need a practical way to spot legal issues in documents and route them to the right specialist.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with property ownership, leases or development transactions is useful. No legal drafting experience is required; coding or programming is not required.
